verses.1: And you, Ephratah, will be young when you are still in the land of Judah. From you, I will come forth to be ruler over Israel. And my descendants will be able to rule from ancient times onward.
verses.2: Therefore, they shall be given to them until they are born again. And their sons will return to the children of Israel.
verses.3: And they stood firm in the power of Jehovah, in His glory. They sat there as if they were now to be exalted above all nations on earth.
verses.4: And it will be a time of peace in Assyria, when it comes into our land. It will walk through our streets, and seven kings and thirty princes of men will stand before it.
verses.5: And they destroyed the land of Assyria at its gates. They also destroyed the land of Nimrod. But they saved it from Assyria, so that it might not enter our land and pass through our borders.
verses.6: And Esau will be among many nations. He will be like a cloud from Jehovah’s hand, covering over the trees that no one can touch or plant.
verses.7: And Esau remained in the nations, among many peoples. He was like a lion in the midst of sheep. He roamed through fields of cattle, where there were no one to protect him from being eaten by predators.
verses.8: May your hands be a help to us in our difficulties, and may all our troubles be resolved.
verses.9: And on that day, the Lord will say, “I will recognize your horses from where they come from.” And I will be carried away in your chariots.
verses.10: And I have known the cities of your land, and I have destroyed all your fortresses.
verses.11: And I have realized that your words are meaningless and worthless. They will not bring you any benefit at all.
verses.12: And I have recognized your flaws and shortcomings from your very nature. Therefore, you shall not worship your own actions anymore.
verses.13: And I will set your servants from your midst, and I will bless your land.
verses.14: And I will take revenge on those nations, both in their eyes and through fire.
